difficulty_reason: The coherator and RQ_X on an affine algebraic space X = Spec(A): identifies Q_X = epsilon^* ∘ Q_{X_0} ∘ epsilon_* through the QCoh equivalence along epsilon : X_etale -> X_{0,Zar} and uniqueness of adjoint functors, computes Gamma(X_0, epsilon_* F) = Gamma(X, F), and derives parts (2) and (3) from the schemes case plus exactness of the A-module association.
